name: skill-session-profiles
description: Manage Codex skill defaults, reusable profiles, and persistent task configuration.
author: Blue

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc --noEmit && vite build && tsup
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.electron.config.ts
